correctness.rationale: The 2m Fourier eigenvalues λ_k=2cos(πk/m)+(−1)^k have reflection-pair degeneracies plus at most one cross-parity collision. Conway–Jones Theorem 7 on two-cosine rational relations (primary full PDF and exact theorem page read) yields the only possible pairs; parity constraints give m≡2 (mod4) with multiplicities (1,2), or m≡3 (mod6) with multiplicities (2,2), mutually exclusive. Hence distinct-eigenvalue count m+1−d, one-trap bright dimension m+1−d, antipodal two-trap bright dimension m+1, for any positive trap strengths; spectral projector ranks justify infinite-time absorption for maximally mixed state. Spectral averaging of mode multiplicity squares gives χ00=(2m−1)/(2m²)+(d4+2d6)/m² and χm0=(2m−1)/(2m²)−(d4+2d6)/m². Independent exact cyclotomic reductions and rational multiplicity counts verified m=3..31; infinite argument uses the full classification not finite checks.
